newsitem.title: USA: Landstar to restructure, take charges.
newsitem.headline: Landstar to restructure, take charges.

text.p: Landstar System Inc said on Wednesday it planned to restructure two of its units and relocate its corporate headquarters, resulting in expected charges of about $9.5 million.
The company said it would restructure its Landstar T.L.C. and Landstar Poole operations and move its corporate headquarters to Jacksonville, Fla.
It would record a charge of about $7.2 milion in the fourth quarter, and recognize the remaining costs in the first and second quarters of fiscal 1997, Landstar said.
The company said it would record a charge of about $1 million in the first quarter and about $1.3 million in the second quarter.
It planned to merge its Landstar T.L.C. unit into its Landstar Inway subsidiary in the first quarter, closing Landstar T.L.C.'s Missouri headquarters.
It also planned to move the variable cost business component of its Landstar Poole unit to Landstar Ranger in Florida in the first quarter, the company said.
The corporate offices would move in the second quarter, Landstar said.
